facts.description: React button component. Awesome button is a 3D UI, progress, social and share enabled, animated at 60fps, light weight, performant, production ready react UI button component. 🖥️ 📱

research.name: React Awesome Button
research.note: React button with a raised 3D face that presses down on click, plus a progress variant that fills a loading bar and social share variants.

effects: raised 3D button face with a darker bottom edge that depresses on press
progress button whose label swaps to a waiting text while a dark bar fills across the face
ripple ring expanding from the pointer on activation
live theme customization through CSS custom property sliders
